articles.title: Coinbase, Kalshi, Kraken parent back CFTC in legal fight over stock perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The Capital Markets Alliance argues that the products fall under the Securities and Exchange Commission’s jurisdiction.

articles.title: A High-Severity Bug Could Have Stalled Bitcoin Mining—Bitcoin Core Has a Fix
articles.snippet: Three bugs—spanning denial-of-service and privacy issues rather than coin theft—have all been patched, with the most serious capable of halting a miner’s ability to build new blocks.

articles.title: Avalanche Won Over the NYSE. Now It Has to ‘Capture Value’ for AVAX
articles.snippet: The New York Stock Exchange will use Avalanche infrastructure, but experts say that won't necessarily boost AVAX's price.
